title: Ginkgo Bioworks Awarded Project Agreement Through BARDA’s BioMaP-Consortium
summary: The goal of the project is to develop novel approaches that strengthen and reduce the costs of domestic biomanufacturing of mAbs to protect against and treat infection by filoviruses such as Ebola and Sudan Viruses.The postGinkgo Bioworks Awarded Project Agreement Through BARDA’s BioMaP-Consortiumappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
